mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the lens holder to the box was worthwhile because it brought the separately assembled lens into the projector’s front opening.

leastWorthwhile.text: Closing the lid was straightforward but less informative than the lens assembly; the text showed the box closed without explaining the lid’s shaped tab.

surprise.text: Nothing particularly surprised me; each new goal followed clearly from the preceding fitting.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary: each fitting had a named part and a clear current goal.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another construction, though this chapter’s predictable text commands alone did not offer much opportunity to explore how the projector works. I cannot assess the pictures or hands-on handling from this text trial.
